title: Navigation | PDF | Global accessibility requirements | Visa Product Design System

blocks.t: Find navigation requirements for testing PDFs.
Page numbering displayed in the PDF viewer page controls has the same page numbering as the document.

items: Inspect the document for page numbers.
Use the keyboard shortcut CMD/CTRL+Shift+N to open a ‘Go To Page’ dialogue.
Enter a page number and click OK.
Verify that the entered page numbers match the actual page numbers of the document (from header/footer).
Pass:Page numbers in PDF reader accurately reflect the Document page number.
Fail: Page numbers in PDF reader do not accurately reflect the document page number.
NA: Page numbers are not available in the document.

blocks.t: Make it possible for users to locate content using bookmarks (outline entries in an Outline dictionary) in documents that are 21 pages or longer.

items: Open the document in Adobe Acrobat Pro.
Open the bookmarks pane and verify that bookmarks are present.
NA: The document is less than 21 pages in length.
